lines.en: See, Joe, that's why your parents told you not to jump on the bed.
No. I'm gonna wear this thing for a couple of weeks.
Did you tell the doctor you did it jumping up and down on your bed?
No. Had a whole story worked out, but then, uh, Chandler sold me out.
Well, I'm sorry, Joe. I didn't think the doctor was gonna buy that it just fell out of the socket.
